note: Private test IPA 672 on the delivered and verified 669, asked by the maintainer on 6 November ("Construit l'ipa avec Metal 4 !"): RPCS3 Core 902 replaces Core 668. Core 902 = Core 668 + the native Metal 4 renderer of the Metal branch, stage M1 (device, MTL4 queue, allocators, fences, residency, compiler, presentation) and stage M2 (RSX programs to MSL through SPIR-V and SPIRV-Cross, the draw path, clears, presentation), compiled with the iOS 26 SDK. Opt-in per title: in-game menu, accuracy tests page, native Metal 4 engine (experimental.metal_renderer); Automatic keeps Vulkan on MoltenVK, so every title behaves as in 669 until the row is enabled; Enabled needs iOS 26. Textures (neutral texture), guest-memory surface loads and writes, MSAA and occlusion queries are counted, not executed yet. MeloNX Core 671 replaces Core 667 (MeloNX session): Hogwarts Legacy keeps MoltenVK fast math again (IPA 669 never reached its first frame: the pipeline cache was compiled again), and a NaN/Inf scrub of FP32 colour outputs and image stores for Hogwarts only against the black sky blocks; Hogwarts rebuilds its shader translations once on its first launch after the update (longer first load, more pipeline compiles in that session). The early JIT escrow logs a VA census (who owns the 4-64 GiB window) for the Assassin's Creed IV JIT arena exhaustion. No iPhone measurement; no FPS claim.
